raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Sixty customers migrated to the new CRM carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of names, and silver_customers passes them through unmapped. raw_region_map provides the code-to-name mapping (01 WEST, 02 EAST, 03 NORTH, 04 SOUTH), so silver_customers should translate codes through that lookup, which also corrects gold_region_daily.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(m.region_name, upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON upper(c.region) = m.region_code;"}}
